completeness.description: The bundled fixture is the complete illustrative SaaS application set for this scenario and reporting window; absent applications have zero illustrative charges.

eligibility.explanation: Eligible only for the complete deterministic illustrative SaaS scenario declared by the bundled governance and analysis fixtures.

net_cost_definition: Illustrative contract commitments contain no modeled credits, taxes, adjustments, or shared-service allocations; reporting-period net cost is the calendar-day overlap allocation of each included commitment.
